skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand economic indicators of a country from production, consumption to wealth accumulation, and the interdependence between economic sectors.
Analyze input-output tables and economic growth factors.
Form opinions and critical thinking in choosing topics and solving macroeconomic problems based on national accounts.
Apply data analysis techniques to input-output tables and economic indicators.
Use economic models to analyze and predict economic growth.
Interpret economic analysis results, compare with economic theories, and evaluate policies to support decision-making.
Conduct statistical analysis of economic data.
Apply research methodologies to economic studies.
Use Microsoft Excel for data analysis and economic modeling.
Participate in discussions and group projects effectively.
